prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1087; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but I understand you need it for the file.

Q: That's understood. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Baytown. I had just pulled into a space near the entrance.

Q: And what was your vehicle doing at the time?

A: I was stopped, waiting for another car to back out of the space across from me. Then a pickup coming down the aisle hit the rear passenger side of my car.

Q: How fast would you estimate the pickup was going?

A: It wasn't fast, maybe walking speed, but the impact was hard enough to jolt me forward and then back into the seat.

Q: Did you feel any injury right away?

A: Not really. I got out, talked to the other driver, and figured I was fine. By that evening my neck was stiff and the pain started spreading into my upper back.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed whiplash and told me to do physical therapy for several weeks. I'm still going twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your neck?

A: I missed two days and I've been limited to lighter duties since then. Turning my head to check mirrors is still painful.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add before we finish?

A: Only that I was following the instructions my doctor gave me, and I want the claim handled so my treatment isn't interrupted.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
